by_rule.description: collections must declare license as an SPDX identifier or 'other'
a mirror should link the upstream STAC with rel:'canonical' when one exists

findings.fix_hint: add a license with an SPDX identifier, e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0', or 'other' plus a rel:'license' link to the license text

findings.fix_hint: add {"rel": "canonical", "href": <the upstream collection.json>, "type": "application/json"} to links when the upstream publishes STAC
